title: OHAO scene (*.scene.json), document version 1
description: Generated from the engine type registry; schemaHash beb22c566b1e50d8. Missing fields take their defaults. Unknown component blocks are preserved; unknown fields inside known components are errors. Ids, parents, cycles and singletons are checked by the engine.

EntityId.description: Stable entity id: 16 lowercase hex digits, never all zero.

AssetRef.description: Asset reference: project-relative path with '/' separators; guid once the asset database exists.

LightType.description: Light shape. Position and direction come from the entity's world transform; the direction is the entity's -Z axis.

Key.description: A keyboard key or mouse button an action or axis is bound to

ColliderShape.description: A collider's shape, fitted to the entity's mesh unless a size is given.

Name.description: Display name for people and agents. Not unique; entities are identified by id.

Transform.description: Local transform relative to the parent (or the world for a root entity). World matrix = parent world * T * R * S.

rotation.description: Local rotation as a unit quaternion, written [x, y, z, w]

scale.description: Local scale per axis; a negative value mirrors

Parent.description: Attaches the entity to a parent; its Transform is then relative to the parent. Cycles are rejected.

entity.description: The parent entity's id; null makes the entity a root

Light.description: A light source. Position and direction come from the transform (direction = -Z).

range.description: Distance at which a Point/Spot light's contribution reaches zero

radius.description: Emitter radius; larger values give softer shadows

outerConeDeg.description: Spot: cone angle where intensity reaches zero

areaEdge1.description: AreaRect: first edge vector, local space

areaEdge2.description: AreaRect: second edge vector, local space

castShadows.description: Whether geometry blocks this light in the raster frame: RT shadows (one shadow-mask channel each, for the first 4 lights that cast them), or the cascaded shadow map for a directional light when RT shadows are off. False lights through everything. The path tracer always traces visibility

ModelAsset.description: A model file (glb, gltf, fbx, obj, dae, blend, 3ds, ply) loaded through the asset resolver; its own materials are used.

asset.description: Project-relative path of the model file, '/' separators

mesh.description: One mesh of a glTF file, by name or '#<index>', at its own origin with only its own materials; empty: the whole file, every node's meshes merged in place

SpherePrim.description: A UV sphere around the origin.

PlatformPrim.description: A flat box (a floor slab or platform) around the origin.

CylinderPrim.description: A capped cylinder along Y, centered on the origin.

ConePrim.description: A capped cone along Y, centered on the origin.

QuadPrim.description: One quad a-b-c-d (triangles a-b-c, a-c-d) with a flat normal and a vertex color.

BoxPrim.description: An axis-aligned box from lo to hi: 6 faces with flat normals and a vertex color.

MeshSource.description: Where the entity's mesh comes from: a model asset or a primitive. Instantiate builds the GPU mesh; entities with equal sources share one mesh.

source.description: Exactly one of the alternatives, as {"Name": {...}}

MaterialOverride.description: The material of a mesh without its own materials (primitives). For a model with materials it only sets the legacy RT GI albedo.

subsurface.description: Subsurface scattering (skin, wax): how much of the lit colour the screen-space blur spreads under the surface; 0 = none. Ignored where emissiveStrength > 0.

Camera.description: The scene camera (one per world). Its pose is the entity's world transform: it looks along -Z with +Y up; roll is ignored.

farPlane.description: Far clip distance (raster passes); keep it above nearPlane

active.description: false: the host keeps its own camera

Environment.description: Image-based lighting (one per world): an equirectangular HDR image lighting and backing the scene.

hdri.description: Project-relative path of the .hdr image; null for none

Spin.description: Turns the entity about an axis of its own frame at a constant rate (the spin system, which runs before the transform system on every world update).

axis.description: Rotation axis in the entity's local frame; any length (normalized), zero for no rotation

degreesPerSecond.description: Turn rate; negative turns the other way

ActionBinding.description: An action name bound to a key: held while the key is down.

action.description: The action's name, as systems and input.inject use it

AxisBinding.description: An axis name bound to two keys: +1 while positive is down, -1 while negative is, 0 for both or neither.

axis.description: The axis's name, as systems and input.inject use it

InputActions.description: The world's controls (one per world): action and axis names over keys. The world's input map is rebuilt from it whenever it is set, changed or removed.

actions.description: Action bindings; an action with several keys is held while any is

FlyController.description: Flies the entity from named axes and actions, once per fixed step: forward along its -Z, right along its +X, up along world +Y; while `look` is held the mouse turns it (yaw about world +Y, pitch about its +X). On the Camera entity it is a fly camera.

moveSpeed.description: Speed at an axis value of 1

lookDegPerUnit.description: Turn per unit of mouse movement while `look` is held

look.description: Action that, while held, lets the mouse turn the entity

fast.description: Action that, while held, multiplies the speed

PlayerController.description: A first-person player: a capsule standing on the entity's position (its feet), turned about +Y. Once per fixed step, before bodies step, it walks from the named axes and actions (forward along its -Z, right along its +X), jumps, climbs steps and slopes, and pushes dynamic bodies. It spawns at the first SpawnPoint tagged "player"; triggers and rays see it.

eyeHeight.description: The eyes above the feet (the first-person camera)

walkSpeed.description: Speed at a move axis of 1

acceleration.description: How fast the horizontal velocity reaches the wanted one

airControl.description: Fraction of the acceleration while in the air

jumpSpeed.description: Upward speed of a jump (4.9 m/s: 1.22 m high)

maxSlopeDeg.description: Steepest walkable ground; steeper is a wall

mass.description: Mass pressing on what it stands on

pushForce.description: The most force it pushes a dynamic body with

lookDegPerUnit.description: Turn per unit of mouse movement, or of a look axis's value in a step

jump.description: Action that jumps when pressed on the ground

sprint.description: Action that, while held, walks at sprintSpeed

lookX.description: Axis turning the player (yaw), added to the mouse's x

lookY.description: Axis tilting the view (pitch), added to the mouse's y

spawn.description: The SpawnPoint tag it spawns at: the k-th character with a tag (creation order) takes the k-th spawn point with it; empty: it starts where it stands

input.description: Moved by the world's input (a player); false: by its MoveIntent (an AI or an agent)

MoveIntent.description: The move a character without input (PlayerController.input false) makes each step, written by the enemy AI or an agent. Absent: it stands still, facing as it faces.

move.description: x right, y forward, in its own frame; each within -1..1

yawDeg.description: The facing to take, about +Y from -Z

Level.description: A level file (glTF) placed in the world. The level system expands it into one child entity per node of the file's default scene (LevelNode), with ids hashed from this entity's id and the node's index; those entities are the file's and are never saved. Node extras give hints (col, body, mass, fric, rest, vis, spawn, socket) and components by name.

asset.description: Project-relative path of the .glb or .gltf file, '/' separators

lightScale.description: Multiplier on the file's KHR_lights_punctual intensities

collision.description: Whether the level's nodes get colliders; false: render only

SpawnPoint.description: A named place to spawn something, at the entity's world position, facing its -Z. Spawns are taken in creation order (a level's node order).

Socket.description: An attach point at the entity's transform (a level's SOCKET_ empties).

name.description: The socket's name, as attachments refer to it

Collider.description: The entity collides: the physics system builds a body for it (static unless it has a RigidBody). A zero size fits the shape to the entity's mesh, in its frame and at its world scale.

size.description: Zero: fit to the mesh. Box: half extents; Sphere: x is the radius; Capsule: x the radius, y the half height of its straight part

offset.description: The shape's centre in the entity's frame, with an explicit size

trigger.description: A trigger volume: reports bodies entering and leaving it (trigger_enter, trigger_exit) and blocks nothing

surface.description: What it is made of, for footsteps on it (concrete, metal, wood, ...); empty is "default"

RigidBody.description: How the entity's body moves. Dynamic bodies are simulated at the world's fixed step and move their entity; static and kinematic ones follow it.

Health.description: Hit points. Damage (a weapon's round, combat.damage) takes current down to 0, which is dead: the dead take no more damage and do not fire.

Weapon.description: A hitscan weapon, fired once per fixed step at most, after physics. A player fires it from its eye along its look by the world's input (`fire`, `reload`); anything else from its origin along its -Z by its WeaponTrigger. Each round is one ray within the spread cone; what it hits takes `damage` if it or an ancestor has Health. Recoil turns a player's view.

automatic.description: Fires while `fire` is held; false: one round a press

magazine.description: Rounds a magazine (the reserve is unlimited)

spreadDeg.description: Half angle of the spread cone at rest

bloomPerShotDeg.description: Added to the cone by each round

bloomMaxDeg.description: The most bloom adds to the cone

bloomRecoveryDegPerSec.description: How fast bloom falls once the fire interval passes without a round

recoilYawDeg.description: View kick sideways a round, at most, either way (seeded)

recoilRecoveryDegPerSec.description: How fast the vertical kick comes back down once the fire interval passes without a round

seed.description: Seed of the spread's and recoil's random numbers

adsTime.description: Time from the hip to the sights (and back); aimed, the cone halves

aim.description: Action that aims down the sights while held (a player's)

WeaponState.description: What a weapon has and is doing. Written by the combat step, which adds it (a full magazine) to a Weapon without one.

cooldown.description: Time until the next round may fire

bloomDeg.description: Added to the spread cone now

kickDeg.description: Vertical view kick not yet recovered

shots.description: Rounds fired: the index of the next round's random numbers

triggerHeld.description: The trigger at the last step (one round a press)

flash.description: Muzzle flash left (the Muzzle's light is on while above 0)

aim.description: 0 from the hip, 1 down the sights; the cone narrows linearly to half

Muzzle.description: A weapon's muzzle flash, on a Light below the weapon's entity: the combat step turns the light to `intensity` for `time` after each round and to 0 otherwise (a light at 0 has no emitter mesh, so the flash is the light's mesh while it is on).

intensity.description: The Light's intensity while the flash is on

time.description: How long the flash stays on after a round

ViewModel.description: A first-person gun, on its root below the camera's entity: its subtree is drawn remapped in view space (toward the eye by depthScale, as if through a fovDeg lens, so it never reaches a wall) and moved at render rate by sway, bob and kick. Presentation only: the motion is never saved or hashed, and lockstep and headless frames draw the rest pose.

fovDeg.description: The lens the gun is drawn through

depthScale.description: Shrink toward the eye in view space

swayDegPerDeg.description: Lag per degree the view turns

swayReturnPerSec.description: How fast the sway returns (exponential rate)

kickReturnPerSec.description: How fast the kick returns (exponential rate)

WeaponTrigger.description: The trigger of a weapon that is not a player's: an AI, a turret or an agent pulls it.

reload.description: Reload now; cleared when acted on

Enemy.description: An enemy: a character (PlayerController with input false) with Health and a Weapon, driven by the enemy AI at the start of each combat step: idle until it sees the player or is hit, then it chases the place it last saw the player, and in range with a clear line it attacks in bursts.

fovDeg.description: The cone it notices the player in while idle

attackRange.description: How near it comes before it stops and fires

reactionTime.description: From first sight to first round

aimErrorDeg.description: At most this off the player, each round (seeded)

loseTime.description: How long it chases without seeing the player

EnemyState.description: What an enemy is doing. The enemy AI writes it, and adds it to an Enemy without one.

lastSeen.description: Where it last saw the player (its feet)

lostFor.description: Since it last saw the player

pause.description: Left of the pause between bursts

lastHealth.description: Its health at the last step (a fall wakes it); < 0: unknown

shotsSeen.description: Its weapon's shots at the last step (counts a burst)

Round.description: The round's rules (one per world). The world's state at the end of its first combat step is the round's start; restartDelay after the player dies, or when `restart` is pressed, the world goes back to it. Every Enemy dead wins the round (it then waits for `restart`).

restartDelay.description: From the player's death to the restart

restart.description: Action that restarts the round now

AudioMix.description: The world's sound bank and mix (one per world): an .audio.json declaring the buses and their voice caps, the sounds (files, bus, priority, distance shape, how long each holds its voice), the ducks, the snapshots and the reverb presets. Without one, the default bank (master over sfx, music, ambient).

asset.description: Project-relative path of the .audio.json file, '/' separators

SkinnedMesh.description: A skinned mesh: the entity's MeshSource (a ModelAsset with `mesh`) is deformed by a skin of a glTF file, posed by the entity's Animator. The instance gets its own deformed copy of the mesh.

skin.description: The skin's name or "#<index>"; empty: the file's first skin

AnimLayerState.description: One layer of an Animator: its state, the steps in it, and the fade from the state it left.

state.description: The layer's current state (empty: its initial state)

from.description: The state faded from; empty when not fading

fade.description: The fade's length in steps (0: none)

Animator.description: Poses an entity by an animation graph (.animgraph.json): each layer's state machine advances one step a simulation step (integers only, so a snapshot holds it exactly). The pose is presentation: never saved or hashed.

layers.description: One a graph layer, in order; empty: filled at the first step

JointAttach.description: Drawn at a joint of its parent's pose (times its own Transform): a rifle in a hand. Presentation: its Transform, and what the step sees, do not follow the joint.

joint.description: The joint's name in the parent's skeleton
